t: What Medical Differential Diagnosis Database Is All About
title: What Medical Differential Diagnosis Database Is All About
description: Differential diagnosis lists what could explain the findings, then narrows by distinguishing evidence: chest pain could be cardiac, pulmonary, GI, or musculoskeletal — the ECG, troponin, and history sort them. Occam's razor favors one unifying diagnosis; Hickam's dictum reminds that patients can have two diseases. Red flags (worst-first thinking) rule out the killers before the common. Reference information for study, not medical advice. This database is the complete differential diagnosis: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
